context: Tests: loading learnings first, qualifying briefly, and short-circuiting on a pattern match.

checklist.name: Learnings file read first
checklist.description: The agent reads learnings.yaml before running any web search

checklist.name: Pattern matched
checklist.description: The agent identifies the 'module not found only in CI' entry as matching the symptom

checklist.name: Fix suggested from the insight
checklist.description: The agent suggests correcting the import casing to match the config.ts file name

checklist.name: OODA skipped
checklist.description: The agent does not start an OODA loop because a pattern matched

checklist.name: Source location given
checklist.description: The agent names src/app.ts and the import line as the location of the fault

checklist.name: Brief qualification only
checklist.description: The agent asks at most three qualifying questions covering stack, environment and recent changes

checklist.name: Search still performed or justified
checklist.description: The agent either runs a quick WebSearch to corroborate or states why the learning makes it unnecessary

checklist.name: User executes the fix
checklist.description: The agent leaves renaming or editing to the user and does not claim to have run it

checklist.name: Verification requested
checklist.description: The agent asks the user to re-run CI and confirm before closing

checklist.name: Artifact written after verification
checklist.description: The thinking artifact is written only after the fix is confirmed, with symptoms, hypotheses tested, root cause and resolution

checklist.name: Learn step offered
checklist.description: After resolution the agent asks whether to save the learning as global, project or skip
